summary: Created B2.1 after browser and API review reproduced a persisted compatibility projection TypeError that broke Workspace and Project Target lists.
Locked strict runtime parsing, bounded legacy normalization, corrupt isolation, reconciliation proof, integrated verification, and no commit or merge as the execution boundary.

Added the strict shared TargetReadModel schema, one bounded legacy compatibility upgrader, relational identity checks, invalid-list isolation, stable detail errors, and explicit reconciliation coverage without mutating snapshots during reads.
Passed 46 focused TypeScript and UI tests, all Go Domain API tests, workspace typecheck, token gates, build, and diff checks.

Proved Browser UI to TypeScript edge to Go Target transaction to PostgreSQL outbox to Go worker to Temporal query on one database; also verified legacy reconciliation, corrupt-list isolation, native and compatibility Workbenches, creation, and all eight Target tabs.

Repository Vitest completed with 401 files passed, 1 skipped, 8 failed; 4705 tests passed, 19 skipped, 30 failed. No B2.1-focused file failed, but the run has six more environment-sensitive runtime-port failures than the prior 24-failure baseline.

Marked B2.1 needs_review. The implementation slice is complete, but direct merge remains gated on an independent review and a clean-host repository test run that restores or improves the inherited baseline.

Extended historical Revision reads to validate source identity against the stable relational mapping, added the regression test, and reran the focused matrix at 47 passing tests plus server typecheck.
